note_to_editors: Win-back pricing. Separate from pricing/catalog.json and not touched by the Dashboard thread. The plans, packages, trials, minutes, annual toggle and HST wording in that catalog do NOT apply here. The compliance wording in `note` (consent, own past customers only, the free pilot terms) is not to be reworded without Amir.
heading: Win-back: reach your past customers
sub: Outbound calls to your own past customers — priced separately from the receptionist, and you can buy either on its own

columns.name: One-time campaign
columns.body: A single push through a list you give us — seasonal maintenance, annual recalls, lapsed customers.

columns.name: Always-on
columns.body: Each customer called automatically when they come due, rather than in one batch.

columns.name: Build and own it
columns.body: We build the system and hand it over, running on phone and AI accounts you own. You pay the providers directly, at cost.

note: The first 20% of your list is a free pilot (at least 25 names, at most 100), so you see your real booking rate before you pay anything. We call your own past customers only — never cold lists or purchased leads. How win-back works.
